description: This Java source file defines an abstract activity class `BaseActivity` for an Android application, providing shared functionality for other activity classes such as handling launch actions, tracking, UI setup, and navigation. It includes lifecycle method overrides, intent handling, UI management, and task setup for testing purposes.

classes.name: BaseActivity
classes.description: An abstract base activity providing common functionalities such as lifecycle management, intent handling, UI setup, and navigation for other activities within the application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures ViewModel and button actions.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Tracks activity resume state and processes any launch forwarding intents.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup and tracking on activity destruction.

methods.name: loadMode
methods.description: Initializes UI fragments based on the specified mode (e.g., LAUNCH).

methods.name: launchActivity
methods.description: Starts another activity, optionally expecting a result, and manages fragment backstack.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received by the activity.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, such as running tests or launching default tasks.

methods.name: askToLaunchTasks
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to the user before launching predefined tasks.

methods.name: setupTaskPreset
methods.description: Creates a predefined set of tasks and activities for testing and demonstration.

methods.name: runIntentTests
methods.description: Attempts to launch test activities related to the project.

methods.name: prepareLaunchForward
methods.description: Prepares and returns the next intent to launch if the activity was started with a forward intent.

methods.name: onUserLeaveHint
methods.description: Overrides to set a flag when the user leaves the activity.
